changeSet.author: samuelmale
changeSet.comment:
A test sent to a reference laboratory is that laboratory's work, and the reports read analysis.referred_out to leave it out of this laboratory's workload. Order Entry raised referrals without ever setting the flag, so a referred test that was never resulted through the Results page still counts as work performed here.
Set the flag for every analysis that carries a live referral. Cancelled and rejected referrals are skipped because both of those transitions clear the flag deliberately: the test comes back to this laboratory. The deprecated CANCELED spelling is skipped alongside CANCELLED.
Analyses already flagged are left alone, so the statement is safe to re-run.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.analysis a SET referred_out = TRUE FROM clinlims.referral r WHERE r.analysis_id = a.id AND (r.status IS NULL OR r.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'CANCELED', 'REJECTED')) AND (a.referred_out IS NULL OR a.referred_out = FALSE);

rollback.comment: Not reversible. Clearing the flag again cannot tell a row this changeset set from one the Results page set correctly years ago, and clearing both would put referred work back into the workload counts.
